title: Validity of a conditional source
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape Boolean Turing machine, let $j$ be a natural number, let $ok$ be a Boolean, and let $\rho$ assign natural numbers to the eleven registers. If $ok$ is true, assume that $1 \leq \rho(rI)$. Then the source that is the $j$th current-cell source when $ok$ is true and the constant false source otherwise satisfies the source validity condition for $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment $\rho$ of natural numbers to eleven registers
